notes.title: Wall World 2 Announcement
notes.content:
The adventure in the mysterious world of the Wall continues! Pilot your robospider into its depths, uncover lost artifacts and technologies, upgrade your exosuit and spider, and battle the horrors lurking in the dark. Unravel the mysteries buried in the depths of the Wall! 

[previewyoutube=CBwohPsHDl4;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]New frontiers, greater dangers.[/b] The Wall is more alive than ever, and this time, it fights back from both within and without. New monster types lurk not only on the surface but deep inside the mines, turning every dig into a battle for survival. Adapt to the ever-changing biomes, overcome hazardous anomalies, and master new ways to traverse the Wall - whether by foot, spider leg, or something even more powerful. 

[b]Upgrade, customize, and conquer.[/b] Your robospider is more than just a machine - it’s your lifeline. Swap out legs for tank treads, enhance its firepower, and fine-tune your exosuit to match your playstyle. From devastating new weaponry to game-changing movement upgrades, Wall World 2 offers deeper progression, letting you build the ultimate digging war machine. 

[b]A living, breathing Wall. [/b]The mines stretch further than before, hiding lost technologies, mysterious artifacts, and uncharted wonders. Sphere City awaits as a hub for upgrades, interactions, and discoveries between expeditions. The deeper you dig, the more secrets you uncover - but be prepared, because some mysteries are better left undisturbed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153968/b21832806d2193dd722cf9fec24f69f313de55d0.gif[/img]
Wall World 2 builds upon everything that made the first game a thrilling rogue-lite adventure - expanding the world, more exciting combat, and adding more ways to explore, fight, and survive. The Wall is calling, Wall diggers. Will you answer? 

Add Wall World 2 to your wishlist to stay updated on the latest news, development progress, upcoming playtests, and the official release date: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3467710/Wall_World_2/

notes.title: AI improvements update 1.0.4
notes.content:
The biggest AI improvements update is now live! Please make sure you have the latest (1.0.4) version of the game installed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43752673/9605bc4a0bbb3f87b00fbe9b897f6712eb8ede26.jpg[/img]

[b]List of changes: [/b]

[list]
[*] Units assigned to "collect resources" won't ignore enemies anymore; instead, they will try to fend them off and avoid taking damage. 
[*] Units assigned to "attack enemies", equipped with ranged weapons, will prioritize attacking enemies and their lairs from a distance. 
[*] Units assigned to "attack lairs" will no longer ignore enemies. They will engage in combat with them, and attack from a distance if equipped with ranged weapons, and try to avoid taking damage. 
[*] Units assigned to "attack lairs" won't just stand in the lair dealing damage to it, but they will try to destroy it, avoiding damage themselves. 
[*] Units assigned to "attack lairs" will try to attack lairs from a minimal distance, ensuring they remain no closer than their combat skills allow. 
[*] Added extra sorting buttons for body parts in the inventory. 
[*] Added hotkeys for spell usage. 
[*] Increased the effects of many artifacts from the treasure trove. 
[*] Fixed an issue with the inability to start the run when combining 2 artifacts. 
[*] Fixed a rare issue with losing the earned gold from runs after exiting the game. 
[*] Fixed other minor issues. 
[/list]
Also, we’re happy to let you know that Steam [url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/2277320/]Community Items[/url] for Necrosmith 2 are already available. Thank you once more for your support and feedback, by which the game is becoming much better!

notes.title: Known issues and upcoming updates
notes.content:
Attention All Necromancers!

We're closely monitoring your feedback and reviews, and we understand that certain aspects of the game may be causing inconvenience. But fear not! We're thrilled to announce that we're currently working tirelessly on not just one, but two big updates that will address many of the issues you've brought to our attention.

These patches will primarily focus on improving the behavior of AI units. Expect significant enhancements such as units intelligently kiting enemies, utilizing ranged attacks when appropriate, and dodging incoming melee strikes. Moreover, units will no longer ignore enemies when they are ordered to "collect". They'll prioritize self-preservation, attempt to dodge attacks, and fight back, all while still obediently following your commands. Additionally, we are implementing balance tweaks and numerous gameplay improvements, including sorting body parts by various attributes like HP, damage, speed, race, and armor.

The first of these updates will be dropping tomorrow! We're eager to share these improvements with you. Also, Steam Community Items are coming soon too!

Thank you for your continued interest in Necrosmith 2 and your unwavering support. Stay tuned for more updates!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2277320/Necrosmith_2/

notes.title: This new necromancy roguelike lets you build your minions bit by bit
notes.content:
Ever since the heady days of Command and Conquer, there's been a simple pleasure in building a base and defending it against enemy onslaught. Such is the way in new Steam game Necrosmith 2, where you take on the role of a powerful necromancer defending their tower using an army of undead allies as you explore the world around you. A sequel to the excellent 2022 roguelike strategy game, itself boasting a resounding 86% Steam rating, you can snag Necrosmith 2 right now at a discount thanks to a generous launch sale.

notes.title: Playtest results and plans
notes.content:
Hi there, necromancers! It’s already 2024, and we're here with several news. 

Playtest for Necrosmith 2 is over! Here’s something we want to share with you to keep you updated on how things are going. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43752673/bde4bf10f0e5a9cc9a61fbed0d3f255eaeda205d.png[/img]

First things first, thank you for your activity, support, and patience during the playtest! We never paused the work, that’s why we've already implemented plenty of changes into the game based on your feedback. Here’s a part of them that will be available in the upcoming demo: 

[list]
[*] Added islands, a new feature that will guide you to new areas with unique environments, body parts, and enemies. 
[*] Added more control settings for units. Now, the player can command their army to [i]‘return to the tower’[/i] and [i]‘patrol assigned territory’[/i]. Also, we split the orders [i]‘attack the enemy’[/i] and [i]‘attack the enemies’ nest’[/i]. 
[*] Added mountains and ranges that will provide you with more tactical opportunities. 
[*] Removed the damage from daylight to friendly units. Walk freely under the sun! 
[*] Removed the exhausting of resource generators. If you’ve captured one, they’ll no longer run out of resources. 
[*] Overhauled the titan creation window. Now it looks clearer and more epic. 
[*] Overhauled the graphics of all water surfaces. 
[*] Overhauled the world generation system. Now, the start of each new run will be more interesting and varied. 
[*] Improved the AI of enemy units. 
[*] Increased the speed of units. 
[/list]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43752673/1db8eb4c0a575f68c6f69526b9d87a51e5492410.gif[/img]

This is just a part of the changes we've finished until the present moment, and we are still working on implementing more content and features. You can try out all the novelties in the demo, which will be a part of the Steam Next Fest next month. Thank you once again, necromancers. 

See you soon! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2277320/Necrosmith_2

notes.title: Playtest is now live
notes.content:
Appeal to all necromancers! 

The lands of Necrosmith need your help once again. New hordes of enemies are coming to defeat you. And we’ve just launched the open playtest for Necrosmith 2, granting access to all comers. Help us protect those lands! 

[previewyoutube=O82LEm-YaGg;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]How to join the playtest: [/b]
[olist]
[*] Visit the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2277320/Necrosmith_2/]Necrosmith 2[/url] Steam page
[*] Click "Request Access" to join the open playtest
[*] Play the game
[*] Leave feedback via the survey in the game
[/olist]
Please, keep in mind that you are playing an early version of the game, which may and will contain errors. That's the reason why your feedback and thoughts are extremely important, helping us shape the game to be exactly what you want to play. Therefore, feel free to discuss, stream, post screenshots, and videos wherever you want – whether it's in the dedicated channel on our [url=https://discord.gg/alawar]Discord[/url] server, on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2277320/discussions/]Steam forum,[/url] or on other social media platforms. We welcome and appreciate it! 

[b]About Necrosmith 2: [/b]
A sequel of an action roguelike sim, where you will start a new life, giving the undead the ability to fly over mountains and swim across rivers, explore a fully procedural generated world at night, fend off enemy hordes during the day, create and fight against titans, upgrade the necromancer’s  tower with various add-ons, and give it a unique look, and many other things.
